intro: Tanzania has about 68 million people from over 120 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: No group dominates; the Sukuma are the largest. Swahili unites the country, and English is also used. Christians and Muslims each make up large shares, and Zanzibar is almost entirely Muslim.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Dar es Salaam is the biggest city; Dodoma is the official capital.
